info.title: Vendor Service — Section 15 purchasing
info.description:
Suppliers, supplier products and exact purchase-unit conversion; purchase orders with configurable approval policies; goods receiving with inspection, discrepancies and immutable purchase-cost evidence; and the operational layer of dashboards, supplier performance, outstanding deliveries and alerts.

Generic Inventory (Section 14) remains the sole physical stock authority. Receiving posts the **accepted** quantity into Inventory and nothing else: damaged, rejected, short and wrong-item quantities become discrepancy evidence and never become sellable stock. Posting is exactly-once per goods receipt.

Purchasing records commercial cost. It never moves money: receiving stock creates no wallet transaction, ledger entry, payout or payment. Financial settlement is a separate authority.

An approved purchase order is a commitment. A supplier invoice above the approved amount does not rewrite it; it raises COST_VARIANCE evidence and follows the configured approval policy.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Repeat-safe key. The same key with the same payload replays the original outcome; the same key with a different payload is a conflict.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Optimistic concurrency. Carries the expected aggregate version; a stale value is refused rather than overwriting a concurrent change.

ConversionMode.description: Purchase-unit conversion is always exact. Approximate conversion is never accepted, because an approximate multiplier would make received stock quantities wrong.

MetricStatus.description: INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY means the metric has no denominator yet. Its value is null and must not be rendered as zero or as a perfect score: a supplier nobody has received from has no on-time rate, not a hundred percent one.

PurchaseCostObservation.description: Immutable commercial evidence of what was actually purchased. Append-only: the database refuses UPDATE and DELETE, and a reversal appends reversal evidence rather than erasing the original. This is not a wallet or ledger transaction and moves no money.

PurchasingCommand.description: Command body. Mutations that change a versioned aggregate carry `expected_version`; a stale value is rejected with 409 rather than overwriting a concurrent change.

SupplierPerformance.description: Evidence-based supplier summary derived from purchase orders, goods receipts, discrepancies and immutable purchase-cost observations. There is no composite score.
